notes.implement: No implement skill per W1-stack-catalog.md's target-stack table: config authoring for this tool family lives in the catalog-wide `deploy` quality skill (src/gdskills/bundled/skills/quality/deploy), not a stack-specific one.
notes.test: No separate test skill. `deploy` already runs the project's build/health-check phases (including `docker compose build`/`docker build`), and validator invocation (hadolint, kubeconform/kubeval, `terraform validate`/`plan`) is covered as part of `docker-k8s-terraform-build-fix`'s reproduce-and-classify step rather than a distinct authoring workflow — there is no separate test-writing concept for this family the way go-testing/python-testing write and extend a test suite.
notes.migrate: No schema/version-migration concept distinct from the build-fix skill's own toolchain-mismatch handling (e.g. a Terraform provider/state version bump) for this pack, mirroring go/python's migrate: [].

auditFocus: a container image built or run as root (no USER instruction, or a Kubernetes securityContext missing runAsNonRoot/allowPrivilegeEscalation: false)
a base image pinned only by a mutable tag (`FROM node:20`) instead of an immutable digest (`FROM node:20@sha256:...`)
a secret (API key, password, token) baked into an image layer via ARG/ENV/COPY instead of a build-time secret mount or runtime injection
a Kubernetes Pod/Deployment with no resource requests/limits, no readOnlyRootFilesystem, or capabilities not dropped to the minimum the container needs
a namespace or workload with no default-deny NetworkPolicy, or one scoped too broadly to serve as a real boundary

a Terraform resource or module with a hardcoded credential/connection string in `.tf`/`.tfvars`, a `sensitive = true` value treated as if that alone encrypted it, or state configured with a local/unencrypted backend
buildCommands: docker build . (or docker compose build for a compose project)
kubeconform -strict -summary <manifest-or-dir> (or kubeval, whichever the project already uses)
terraform validate && terraform plan (only plan, never apply, from this skill)
fixGuardrails: Never remove a USER/securityContext non-root setting, drop a NetworkPolicy, or relax a capability drop just to make a build/deploy pass.
Never bake a secret into an image layer (ARG/ENV/COPY of a credential) to route around a missing runtime secret — use a build-time secret mount or say the runtime wiring is still needed.
Never commit or read a `.tfstate` file as the source of truth for a fix, and never suggest disabling remote state locking to unblock a run.
Never widen a Terraform `sensitive = true` removal or a K8s NetworkPolicy loosening to silence a validator finding without saying so in the report.
